items.summary: Block/Item settings must carry a RegistryKey; missing it fails with 'NullPointerException: Item id not set' at registry time.
items.why: The call to Settings#registryKey is a member reference and is visible, but its absence is a call that was never emitted: nothing in the bytecode says it is required.

items.summary: Server-only methods now take ServerWorld explicitly; callers must pass it instead of casting.
items.why: The descriptor of the called method changes, so an exact-match site either misses or needs a call-site adaptation.

items.summary: ActionResult / ItemActionResult / TypedActionResult merged into ActionResult.
items.why: Return types and static factory owners change: member lookups fail or need bridges.

items.summary: EntityRenderer gains a render-state type parameter; createRenderState / updateRenderState split rendering data from the entity instance.
items.why: The renderer's method set and descriptors change. Whether the ported renderer still looks right is NOT visible here.

items.summary: Registry implements RegistryEntryLookup: getEntry->getOptional, entryOf->getOrThrow, getOrThrow->getValueOrThrow, and siblings.
items.why: Method names change; exact-match lookups miss.

items.summary: Recipes keyed by RegistryKey; Recipe/ID server-side only; clients get RecipeDisplayEntry with NetworkRecipeId.
items.why: Method signatures move, but the client/server split is a protocol change: a signature that still resolves can still be wrong at runtime.

items.summary: Ingredient is internally a list of items, not item stacks.
items.why: Type stays Ingredient, so only calls that read stacks reveal it.

items.summary: Shared profiler is accessed through Profilers#get instead of world.getProfiler().
items.why: Call owner/descriptor change.

items.summary: EntityAttributes constants drop the GENERIC prefix and their identifiers change.
items.why: Static field names change; references miss.

items.summary: LootTables#EMPTY removed; absence is Optional now.
items.why: Field reference disappears.

items.summary: Furnace fuels register through FuelRegistryEvents.BUILD with a context. FuelRegistry.INSTANCE.add is gone.
items.why: Owner/API type change.

items.summary: EntityType.Builder#build now requires a RegistryKey; the no-arg build injected by FabricEntityTypeBuilder was removed.
items.why: Descriptor change on build().

items.summary: Creating an entity requires a SpawnReason.
items.why: Descriptor change on create().

items.summary: Recipe providers override getRecipeGenerator instead of generate.
items.why: Override signature changes; the override silently stops being called if it is not migrated.

items.summary: Items use assets/<ns>/items/*.json model definitions; ItemColors and related tinting APIs were removed.
items.why: Removed Java APIs are visible; a missing JSON asset is only visible to a resource scan, and a model that loads but looks wrong is not visible to either.

items.summary: BlockEntity#getRenderType is gone: every block entity renders its block model.
items.why: The override target disappears from the target index.

items.summary: Model Loading API split into static vs block models; BeforeBake/AfterBake removed; GroupableModel no longer extends UnbakedModel.
items.why: Types and callback interfaces change.

items.summary: Pick Block moved from client to logical server; client callbacks replaced by PlayerPickItemEvents.
items.why: The client callback API is visible when it is removed; whether a mod's pick logic is now on the right side is a runtime question.

items.summary: CustomIngredient#getMatchingStacks returns a stream, not a list.
items.why: Return type change on an override.

items.summary: Equipment assets moved from models/equipment to assets/<ns>/equipment; several tags removed; slot outline textures moved.
items.why: Pure asset layout: no bytecode reference points at a resource path that can be checked without a resource scan and a visual comparison.

items.summary: fabric-rendering-v0 and FabricModelPredicateProviderRegistry removed; BuiltinItemRenderer replaced by SpecialModelTypes.ID_MAPPER access widener.
items.why: Removed API classes are visible in the API index.
